points.en: WIPO is one of the 15 specialized agencies of the United Nations.

points.en: Established in 1967, it aims to promote the protection of intellectual property (IP) worldwide.
points.hi: Established in 1967, it aims to promote the protection of intellectual property (IP) worldwide.

points.en: It administers 26 international treaties related to IP rights.

points.en: Provides a forum for developing international IP rules and policies.

points.en: Offers global services for protecting inventions, trademarks, and designs.
points.hi: Offers global services for protecting inventions, trademarks, and designs.

points.en: Assists developing countries in building IP infrastructure.

points.en: Publishes the Global Innovation Index (GII) annually.
